perf.summary: In the 64-bit branch, inline the hash instead of calling ulong.GetHashCode().
perf.currentCost: The else branch returns this.Value.GetHashCode(), which for ulong does (int)(value ^ (value >> 32)) but goes through a framework call that Burst/JIT must inline; the 32-bit branch already inlines as (int)Value.
perf.proposedChange: Return (int)(this.Value ^ (this.Value >> 32)); directly to mirror the manual folding and avoid relying on the BCL call being inlined.
perf.rationale: Direct xor-fold is two ALU ops and matches the documented ulong hash; removing the method-call boundary helps when DtPolyRef is used as a dictionary/hashset key in managed test/build code (not Burst hot path, hence low impact).
perf.risk: Must reproduce ulong.GetHashCode's exact algorithm to preserve hash distribution behavior; .NET's ulong.GetHashCode is (int)(m_value ^ (m_value >> 32)), so the inline is bit-identical. Safe.
